messages:
alex: Heads up — did a helm upgrade of release model-serving in us-west. Post-upgrade hook job failed and Argo shows the app Degraded. Not obvious why.
priya: which chart version? any error logs from the hook pod?
alex: chart v3.1.0; hook is a post-upgrade job that migrates CRs. Hook pod logs show `error: unable to recognize "": no matches for kind "ModelConfig" in version "inference.redwood.ai/v1beta"`
sam: that sounds like CRD apiVersion changed in the chart. Did the CRD manifest get applied before the hook runs?
alex: helm upgrade has CRD templates but CI disables CRD install to avoid clobbering. CRDs are managed separately via gitops/infra. Cluster only had v1alpha.
priya: Argo has been auto-syncing CRDs from infra repo — any recent PRs changing CRD group/version?
sam: I saw a migration PR merged to staging last night but it wasn't promoted to prod. There was a tf-apply that bumped operator image, might have assumed CRD was present.
ops-bot: deploy-bot detected Helm hook job failure for release=model-serving namespace=ml-serving pod=model-migrate-5f8b
alex: paused Argo sync for that app and scaled the hook job to 0 to stop the retry spam. Need a remediation plan.
priya: two options: (1) apply the v1beta CRD manifest manually from the chart, then re-run the hook; (2) patch the hook job to skip migration if CRD not present and roll forward. Which is safer for prod data?
sam: manual CRD apply is safest if the change is additive, but snapshot CRs first. Also watch for CRs stuck Terminating due to old finalizers.
alex: ran `kubectl get modelconfigs --all-namespaces -o yaml > /tmp/modelconfigs.backup.yaml` and saved a backup. Then `kubectl apply -f crds/inference.redwood.ai_modelconfigs_v1beta.yaml` from the chart tarball. Output: `customresourcedefinition.apiextensions.k8s.io/modelconfigs.inference.redwood.ai configured`.
alex: re-ran hook; now failing with `conversion webhook failed: unsupported conversion` — looks like the conversion webhook deployment isn't ready yet.
priya: check cert-manager and the validatingwebhookconfiguration: `kubectl -n cert-manager logs deploy/cert-manager` and `kubectl describe validatingwebhookconfiguration modelconfigs-webhook`. Any TLS errors?
alex: cert-manager logs look healthy, but webhook failing with `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` — operator didn't rotate webhook certs after CRD update.
sam: operator pod might be CrashLoop or missing RBAC to write certs. `kubectl -n ml-serving get pods` shows operator Pending/CrashLoopBackOff and errors about create certificate permission denied.
priya: quick mitigation options: (A) temporarily remove the conversion webhook from the CRD so hooks can run (risky), (B) promote the CRD PR to prod so Argo will sync CRD + operator together and the operator can reconcile and provision certs, then rerun hook.
alex: I prefer promoting the PR and letting Argo handle it in the correct order. I'll pause only the infra repo sync while we prepare. Steps I propose: `1) promote CRD PR to prod branch, 2) unpause Argo for infra repo only, 3) watch operator rollout and webhook readiness, 4) re-run the helm hook job (or run a one-off job) to migrate CRs, 5) monitor modelconfigs for conversion errors and roll back if needed.`
sam: sounds good. I'll review the CRD diff for breaking changes and coordinate on-call. Also prepare rollback: revert operator image and restore CRD served versions to v1alpha if conversion fails.
ops-bot: scheduled promotion request created: infra/prod branch deploy request #4672
sam: approved. I'll coordinate with platform on-call to monitor GPU serving traffic during the window 15:30-15:50 UTC.
alex: tagging @sam for approval and starting promotion now. I'll post brief updates here as we progress. :thumbsup:
